en-US: Try a local Linux wheel, read and write files through the mounted workspace, or run separate commands in a main task and a delegated task. The memory library shows which items are linked or fading. Open a memory to edit an outdated fact.
zh-Hans: 可以用本地 wheel 测试 Linux 离线装包，在挂载工作区里读写文件，或让主任务与子任务分别执行命令。长期记忆会显示关联和遗忘状态，打开记忆详情可改写旧事实。
